title: Orevolution-Spelunkery Compat
description: A compatibility layer between Orevolution! and Spelunkery
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7e15d73f8236b741ff6745eb47c5ff936e62d4a.png)

About this mod:

**Orevolution-Spelunkery Compat** is an addon that automatically integrates Spelunkery's features into orevolution, currently including ore variants and raw nuggets for tin, platinum (Diorite/Granite/Andesite/Tuff) and for Tungsten (Blackstone/Basalt).

Obviously, this mod requires both [Spelunkery](https://modrinth.com/mod/spelunkery) and [Orevolution](https://modrinth.com/mod/orevolution) to work
